title: Load a coasting cart, throw the switch, recover the part
summary: A small cube (the part) rides a powered roller conveyor, and an unpowered cart is already coasting along a straight channel towards a passive hinged switch that splits the track into two diagonal branches. Grasp the part with both fingers while it is still moving and lift it, drop it into the moving cart, then push the switch with a finger so that it will steer the cart into the branch selected for this instance (one of the two sides, drawn per instance and given under Goal geometry) before the cart reaches it. The cart must then be deflected by the switch into that branch. Finally, grasp the part again, lift it out of the cart and hold it up before the cart runs too far down the branch.
robot_setup: One Panda, base at (-0.55, 0, 0) facing +x (yaw 0). No tool: the stock Panda hand with its two fingers. The tool frame (the reported tool pose) is the hand's TCP, the point between the fingertips, with its z axis pointing out of the hand along the fingers. At the start the TCP is at (-0.13, -0.13, 0.20) with the gripper pointing straight down (orientation wxyz (0, 1, 0, 0)). The fingers close along world y and start fully open (aperture 0.08 m; the action's last component is the total aperture, 0 to 0.08 m). In this task the finger motion is not time-synchronised with the arm joints, so a finger command does not stretch the arm motion. The finger servo damping is also raised to 8.
scene: The part is an orange cube with 36 mm edges. It sits on a short roller conveyor of 20 thin grey rollers, which spin by themselves and carry it towards the conveyor's open end; past that end it drops to the table. The cart is a small blue open tray, 0.13 m x 0.11 m inside with 12 mm walls. It rides on four free orange ball bearings (radius 18 mm) and has no motor: it is already coasting at t = 0 and keeps rolling straight. It first passes between two parallel static walls (an entry channel, 16 mm thick and 5 cm tall), then meets the switch. The switch is a passive vertical blade (12 mm thick, 0.14 m long, 45 mm tall) on a vertical hinge with joint friction and no spring, and it carries a small knob on top of its free end. At the start the blade points straight back along the cart's path, edge-on to the incoming cart. Beyond the switch there are two diagonal branches, one on each side. Each has a static guide rail (16 mm thick, 0.24 m long, 5 cm tall) and, at its far end, a shallow static open box (dock, 0.14 m x 0.12 m inside, 18 mm walls). The table top is the world's z = 0 plane.
scene_privileged: Conveyor: 20 rollers (radius 6 mm, 0.136 m long along x) with axes spaced 12.5 mm along y, centred on (-0.16, -0.13); roller axes at z = 0.108, so the roller tops are at z = 0.114. Their axes run from y = -0.24875 to y = -0.01125. Each roller is velocity-driven at -`incoming_speed`/0.006 rad/s about x, so its top surface moves along +y at `incoming_speed` (0.08 m/s). The rollers start already spinning; the motor damping is 0.012 N m s/rad with a 0.008 N m torque cap. Part: cube with 0.018 m half-size, mass `object_mass` (0.035 kg), friction 0.65. At reset its centre is at (-0.16 + dx, -0.18, 0.133) with velocity (0, `incoming_speed`, 0); dx ~ U(-0.004, 0.004) is drawn at reset. With the robot idle it rides off the conveyor's +y end at about t = 2.3 s and lands on the table. Cart: chassis (named `cart`) is an open tray (half 0.065 x 0.055, walls 0.012 m, floor 5 mm) of mass 0.16 kg, friction 0.4. Its origin is the centre of the floor's top surface, at reset (0, -0.41 + dy, 0.045), with dy ~ U(-0.01, 0.01) drawn at reset (drawn before dx). Initial velocity is (0, `fixture_speed`, 0) = 0.04 m/s. Four bearing balls (`cart_bearing_0..3`: radius 0.018, mass 0.008 kg, friction 0.65, restitution 0.02) sit at chassis offsets (+-0.05, +-0.04, -0.026). Each is held by a joint that locks translation but leaves rotation free, and each starts with spin (-`fixture_speed`/0.018, 0, 0) rad/s (rolling). There is no motor; with the robot idle the cart coasts at about 0.04 m/s and stops at y = 0.10 against the tip of the unturned switch (around t = 13 s). Entry walls: static boxes 0.016 x 0.20 x 0.05 m centred at (+-0.083, -0.22, 0.025). Switch (`switch` link on `switch_base`): hinge at (0, 0.30, 0.01) about the world z axis; q > 0 is counterclockwise seen from above, limits +-1.5 rad, joint friction 0.08, damping 0.001, no drive. The blade is 0.012 x 0.14 x 0.045 m and runs from the hinge towards -y at q = 0 (tip at y = 0.16), covering z 0.01 to 0.055. A knob 0.032 x 0.024 x 0.024 m is centred over the blade tip at z = 0.08. The switch is reset to q = 0 at rest. Branch rails `branch_rail_1` / `branch_rail_-1`: static boxes 0.016 x 0.24 x 0.05 m centred at (+0.16, 0.43, 0.025) / (-0.16, 0.43, 0.025), yawed by -0.55 / +0.55 rad. The +x rail runs from about (0.097, 0.328) to (0.223, 0.532). Docks: static open boxes (half 0.07 x 0.06, walls 0.018) with floor top at z = 0.003, centred at (+-0.16, 0.46). Table friction `table_friction` (0.08). Seeded draws at reset, in this order: dy, dx, then `branch` = rng.choice([-1, +1]). `target` = (0.0, 0.30, 0.08), a point above the switch hinge that no predicate uses.

phases.name: moving_part_pickup
phases.text: Both fingers grip the part (bilateral grip: the left finger or its pad and the right finger or its pad are both in contact with the part at that physics step) at some moment when the part moves faster than 0.025 m/s. After that (same or later step), with the part still gripped, its centre is higher than z = 0.20 m.

phases.name: load_coasting_cart
phases.text: At a step when the part is not gripped by both fingers, the part touches the cart's tray while the cart moves faster than 0.02 m/s.

phases.name: physical_switch_operation
phases.text: During this phase a finger (either finger or finger pad) touches the switch. After that, at some step: the switch angle q (about the vertical hinge, counterclockwise seen from above; q = 0 is the blade pointing from its hinge towards -y) is turned towards the selected branch by more than 0.50 rad, i.e. -branch x q > 0.50 (q < -0.50 rad when branch = +1, the +x side; q > +0.50 rad when branch = -1); the switch turns slower than 0.12 rad/s; and the cart's origin is still at y < 0.105. If, before this, the cart touches the switch or its origin passes y = 0.105, the task fails (missed_switch_deadline).

phases.name: selected_branch
phases.text: During this phase the cart touches the switch and touches the guide rail of the selected branch (`branch_rail_{branch}`), in either order. Then the cart's origin is at y > 0.23 and on the selected side, with branch x x > 0.08 (x > 0.08 for branch +1, x < -0.08 for branch -1).

phases.name: payload_recovery
phases.text: Both fingers grip the part, its centre is more than 0.10 m above the cart's origin (the centre of the cart floor's top surface), and the part does not touch the cart, for 0.5 s without interruption. This completes the task.

task_failures: missed_switch_deadline: during physical_switch_operation, the phase's completion condition is not met at a step where the cart touches the switch or the cart's origin is at y > 0.105.
loaded_cart_spill: during physical_switch_operation or selected_branch, the part's centre drops below z = 0.018 m (it is lying on the table).
missed_downstream_recovery_window: during payload_recovery, the cart's origin reaches |x| > 0.27 or y > 0.43.
contact_rules: No tool is mounted. Only the finger links (fingers and finger pads) may touch anything. They may touch the part, the cart's tray and its bearing balls (all free objects), and the moving blade/knob of the switch (`switch`). The fingers may not touch the conveyor (its rollers or its base), the switch base, the entry walls, branch rails, docks or the table. No other part of the robot (hand, links, base) may touch anything. Finger-to-finger contact is allowed.
world_goals_fixed: Lines in the world frame used by the predicates: part lift height z = 0.20 m; switch deadline y = 0.105 for the cart's origin; branch reached at y > 0.23 with |x| > 0.08 on the selected side; recovery window ends at |x| = 0.27 or y = 0.43 for the cart's origin.
world_goals_seeded: `branch` (+1 = +x side, -1 = -x side) is drawn at reset from the instance's random stream. It is stored in the task's flags but is NOT among the exported goal_* observations, and nothing in the scene shows it. `goal_target` is announced at reset. It is not seeded, but it marks the switch hinge position (raised), so it is privileged mode only; no predicate uses it.
difficulty_note: The part must be grasped from a moving conveyor and dropped into a cart that is already rolling. The switch has to be turned before a deadline that the coasting cart sets. The part must then be picked out of the cart while it is still moving, before it leaves the recovery window.
standard_notes: At t = 0 the part is already moving along the conveyor and drops off its end within a few seconds. The cart is already coasting and keeps rolling at constant speed (it has no motor) until something stops it. Nothing in the images marks the selected branch: it is given under Goal geometry.

instance_goal.text: At this instance the selected branch is branch -1: the diagonal branch on the -x side (the side nearer the robot's base).
